architecture_principles: a discovered material regularity is only usable inside the chemistry family in which it was measured
a scientific applicability boundary is executable code, not prompt advice
the language model may criticize the rule and may not override it
value of information is computed by a deterministic tool over the admissible set only
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
every gate decision carries a machine-readable reason and is serialized with the run

arm_difference_declaration.forbidden_confound: Hiding applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL is prohibited by protocol v1.1.
held_identical: model endpoint and stage model assignment
evidence access profile and filtered evidence state
raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for every candidate
the full inadmissible-card list and its machine-readable reasons
VOI implementation, weights and tie epsilon
arm_difference_declaration.information_parity_evidence: build_pre_enforcement_payload() takes no arm argument, and its SHA-256 is written into every run as pre_enforcement_payload_sha256. The two arms must report the same hash.
arm_difference_declaration.only_intended_difference: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
arm_difference_declaration.payload_consequence: Both arms receive the same audit, the same per-candidate applicability outputs and the same inadmissible-card list. V5_NO_GATE marks the audit advisory and keeps every card selectable; V5_FULL marks it binding and removes the inadmissible cards from the ranked set.

candidate_space.rationale: V5 reuses the byte-identical V3/V4 lattice so that the measured change is the chemistry-domain constraint, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> mandatory chemistry-audited local science tool -> deterministic chemistry-domain applicability audit (identical and model-visible in both arms) -> enforcement (V5_FULL only) -> VOI over the selectable set -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze

rules: M-HOLD-120 is admissible: it measures thermal-hold drift directly and does not use the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT is admissible: it measures realization/state spread directly.
M-SWEEP is admissible: it is the direct verification measurement for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use equal to allowed_with_state_anchor, or when configs/verified_shape_transfer.json records a completed direct sweep for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification. This is deterministic inadmissibility, not a VOI penalty and not prompt advice.

architecture.claim_boundary: V5.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime with a deterministic chemistry-domain admissibility constraint. A V5 result is evidence about executable scientific constraints on measurement choice. It is not a wet-lab result and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.manuscript_boundary: V5 run results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the run series is audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_CHEMISTRY_GATED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V5
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information or admissibility
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
re-running, rewriting or reinterpreting the frozen V4 series

primary_arms.role: advice-only control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint
prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

architecture.purpose: Test whether an experimentally discovered material regularity and its chemistry-domain boundary can be executed as a hard scientific constraint on which measurement an outcome-blind Agent is allowed to select.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question the next experiment must answer, and request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations
execute read-only scientific tools. The chemistry-audited local rheology summary is mandatory and is forced into the trace whether or not the planner requested it.

deterministic, non-LLM measurement-applicability audit. Computed once per run without reference to the arm, fully visible to the model in both arms, serialized in full, and never produced by a model stage.
V5_FULL only. Converts the identical audit into hard admissibility before VOI ranking and again at freeze. It cannot be overridden by any model stage.
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value from the cards present in the payload
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability and whether its falsification criterion can actually be met
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported weight sensitivity and the strongest objection
commit to one experiment card present in the payload, or abstain, and state its acceptance and falsification criteria
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card. A selection outside the admissible set is rejected at freeze rather than repaired.

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V5 is a new prospective runtime. configs/agent_v4.json, scripts/run_agent_v4.py, prompts/agent_v4_*.txt, src/pur_new/voi.py and every frozen V3/V4 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V5.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards

decision_stability_sent_to_model.evaluated_over: the selectable experiment cards of this arm
decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Accept S1C41 as avoiding the observed high-drift failure mode if the mean SI_15_60 is less than or equal to 9.51%, the directly measured E1 matched-window value.
judge_normalized.chemistry_support_statement: The primary observable does not depend on a rheological regularity measured in the same chemistry family as S1C41. It is a direct matched-window hold measurement in the modified AC1920-plus-TK100 chemistry, so no unmodified-family thermal-response shape is transferred. The result supports only a formulation-level claim about S1C41 hold drift, not a molecular mechanism or the broader modifier region.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: If the mean SI_15_60 is greater than or equal to 51.54%, the directly measured E5 matched-window value, falsify H1_formulation_family as instantiated by S1C41 because this candidate has not reduced E5-like drift. If the mean is less than or equal to 9.51%, the E5-like persistence account is falsified for S1C41 and H1_formulation_family is supported for this candidate. Values strictly between 9.51% and 51.54% indicate partial mitigation and neither accept nor falsify H1 at the preregistered endpoints.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run matched 120 C hold trajectories on at least three independently prepared S1C41 batches under fully recorded process histories, together with an identically handled unmodified E2 control, to determine whether the high drift is reproducible or realization-state dependent before changing composition.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Mean SI_15_60 across at least two independent preparations, where SI_15_60 = 100 * (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15 at 120 C, reported in percent.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C41::M-HOLD-120 is audit-admissible, directly measures the declared excessive-hold-drift failure mode, and avoids unsupported shared-shape transfer. The 15% AC1920 plus 5% TK100 intervention is within the supplied analogue-supported region and has lower modifier burden than the sweep proposal. The experiment can establish only whether this realized formulation shows E1-like, intermediate, or E5-like rheological drift.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I follow the Skeptic rather than the Proposer and Robustness Adjudicator on the decisive interpretability issue. Their preferred S1C51::M-SWEEP directly measures candidate viscosity, but its stated candidate-versus-E2 observable and 3.40% hypothesis criteria are unattainable from the specified candidate-only, single-preparation protocol given the missing concurrent E2 reference and large historical realization spread. I therefore depart from the deterministic VOI ranking and select the explicitly available S1C41::M-HOLD-120 card, which directly tests the declared 120 C failure mode with a checkable observable. This does not resolve the registered level hypotheses.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: High. Local 120 C hold evidence consists of one E1 and one E5 trajectory, and there are no prior local hold trajectories for AC1920- or TK100-modified candidates.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: Compositionally, S1C41 lies within the stated 15-25% acrylic-like region and its 5% tackifier loading lies within the 4.8-6.4% analogue cluster. Nevertheless, its hold behavior is new local chemistry evidence; analogue support does not predict the outcome.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: M-HOLD-120 directly observes SI_15_60 and has a declared 2.0 percentage-point resolution with at least two independent repeats; no curve reconstruction or temperature extrapolation is required.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: Substantial. Historical E2 preparations had 46-58% CV and 2.80-3.57-fold spread. Two hold repeats reduce but do not fully characterize this source of variability.

planner.chemistry_support_statement: The shared local temperature-response regularity was measured in the original reactive-PUR chemistry represented by E1, E2, and E3, with the E1 phosphoric-acid perturbation treated as a separate compatibility check rather than part of the primary same-composition fit. An experiment introducing acrylic-like or minor tackifier-like material would leave that directly measured chemistry support, so the shared shape cannot be assumed; direct M-SWEEP verification is required unless candidate-specific applicability is subsequently established.
planner.failure_mode: Excessive isothermal viscosity drift during residence at 120 C, creating thermal-hold instability in the local design.
planner.failure_mode_evidence: The original E5 hold increased by SI_15_60 = 0.5154 (51.5%) and SI_15_90 = 0.9308 (93.1%) at 120 C, compared with 9.5% and 16.8%, respectively, for E1 over the same windows.
planner.least_resolved_justification: Only E1 and E5 have local hold data, each represented by one four-point run at 120 C over 15-90 min. There are no measured hold trajectories for an acrylic-like or tackifier-like candidate and no independent hold repeats. By contrast, temperature response is covered by multiple six-point 80-130 C sweeps. Realized level is also uncertain because E2 has 46-58% nominal-run CV and 2.80-3.57 max/min ratios, but it has substantially more observations than the time coordinate.
measurement_requirements: Measure the candidate directly across 80-130 C in 10 C increments on a freshly prepared sample so that the 120 C and 130 C processing-window levels are observed rather than extrapolated from an unverified shared shape.

Measure a matched unmodified E2 reactive-core reference under the same preparation and measurement order, allowing the candidate level to be compared with the preregistered dilution, association, and plasticization predictions.

Use sufficient independent preparations to quantify realization-state uncertainty, because E2 nominal runs show 46-58% CV and approximately 2.8-3.6-fold max/min spread; hypothesis separation must exceed the empirically established measurement resolution.

For direct-sweep interpretation, preregister the 3.4% shared-shape-plus-intercept residual as the lower discrimination scale, but replace it with the larger observed repeatability bound if independent-preparation variability is larger.
Run the matched-window 120 C hold with at least two independent repeats and record viscosity at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min; report SI_15_60 directly without extrapolation or imputation.
Keep the level-hypothesis adjudication separate from hold-stability adjudication, because the registered level hypotheses make no claim about thermal-hold drift.
Preserve the source viscosity unit as unknown unless source-level evidence resolves it.
planner.scientific_question: For an E2-anchored formulation containing an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like modifier, is the matched-temperature realized viscosity level above, consistent with, or below the preregistered inert-dilution prediction, and does the formulation avoid E5-like viscosity growth during a 120 C hold? A level above dilution would distinguish H-LEVEL-ASSOC, agreement with dilution would support H-LEVEL-DILUTE, and a level below dilution would support H-LEVEL-PLASTIC.

proposer.chemistry_support_assessment: S1C51 is an unvalidated AC1920-plus-TK100 modified chemistry outside the family in which the shared thermal-response shape was measured. M-SWEEP is nevertheless admissible under the binding audit because it directly measures the processing-window viscosity and establishes the response shape for this chemistry rather than transferring the unmodified-family shape. Both intervention axes are within externally supported regions: 20% acrylic-like loading is directly supported by approximately 19-20% analogue examples, and 5% minor tackifier lies in the repeated 4.8-6.4% cluster.
hypotheses_not_separated: None among the registered level hypotheses; this experiment does not separate or adjudicate thermal-hold drift hypotheses, which are outside the level registry.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: A measured 120-130 C level change within 3.40 percentage points of exactly one preregistered prediction identifies the corresponding formulation-level account: -51.29% supports H-LEVEL-DILUTE, +28.71% supports H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or -88.79% supports H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. This establishes the level behavior only, not hot-hold stability or a molecular mechanism.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: A level at or below -51.29% falsifies H-LEVEL-ASSOC; a level at or above -51.29% falsifies H-LEVEL-PLASTIC; and a departure greater than 3.40 percentage points from -51.29% falsifies H-LEVEL-DILUTE. Thus an outcome near or below the inert-dilution boundary would directly falsify the associative elevation hypothesis despite the acrylic loading.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: If the result is not within 3.40 percentage points of exactly one prediction, no registered level hypothesis is accepted for this composition. The outcome may indicate behavior between the preregistered models or may be confounded by realization-state variability, which is a substantial concern given the historical E2 preparation spread. Independent preparations would then be needed before mechanistic interpretation.

proposer.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level at 120 and 130 C within the 80-130 C sweep, expressed as the matched-temperature percentage change against the unmodified E2 reactive core; the fitted E_eta descriptor is secondary.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It has identical deterministic VOI and lower modifier burden, but its 15% acrylic point is supported only as a directional lower-region value with an unverified literature fraction denominator, whereas 20% has repeated directly commensurate support.
It has identical deterministic VOI but uses a 17.5% interpolated acrylic loading rather than the directly supported approximately 19-20% region.
It has identical deterministic VOI and remains supported, but the 22.5% acrylic loading creates a larger chemistry perturbation without improving hypothesis-pair separation or measurement directness.
It has identical deterministic VOI and a directly supported 25% acrylic anchor, but it carries the greatest modifier burden in the tied set without additional discrimination.

It directly interrogates the declared hot-hold failure mode, but it separates none of the registered level hypotheses and does not return the processing-window level; its VOI is 0.330833 versus 0.6875 for the selected sweep.

proposer.reasoning: S1C51::M-SWEEP is a top-tied, audit-admissible direct measurement that separates all three registered hypothesis pairs at the preregistered 3.4% discrimination scale. Unlike an M-ANCHOR card, it does not infer modified-chemistry behavior from an unverified unmodified-family shape. The composition covers both independently supported modifier axes with zero reported extrapolation risk. Its principal limitation is moderate process-state risk: one fresh-sample sweep cannot resolve the large historical between-preparation variability, and it does not answer the separate thermal-hold drift question.
proposer.tie_break_justification: All five cards have the same VOI component vector, directly measure the decision quantity, and separate all three hypothesis pairs. S1C51 was chosen because its 20% acrylic loading is centered on repeated, directly commensurate approximately 19-20% external examples while its 5% tackifier loading lies in the repeated minor-resin cluster. It therefore has stronger compositional support than the provisional 15% lower point and imposes less modifier burden than the 22.5% and 25% alternatives.

residual_decision_risk: The specified card lacks a concurrently prepared unmodified E2 reference, so the matched percentage change required by the registered level hypotheses is not directly obtained.
One candidate preparation does not quantify realization-state variability; the 3.40% fit residual is not an adequate discrimination threshold against the much larger historical E2 preparation spread.
The AC1920-plus-TK100 dual-axis intervention cannot attribute an observed elevation or depression specifically to AC1920, TK100, their interaction, or realization state.
The dilution prediction and phi_r = 0.75 remain conditional on AC1920 and TK100 being non-reactive; modifier functionality and effective NCO:OH stoichiometry are unverified.
M-SWEEP does not test the declared 120 C thermal-hold failure mode, so it cannot establish avoidance of E5-like residence-time viscosity growth.
The five-way top tie is resolved using compositional support and modifier burden rather than a score difference; all tied cards retain the same referencing, replication, and attribution limitations.
The 0.002292 margin to the first strictly lower card is small even though no tested single-weight scaling changed the tied top set.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection does not identify another available experiment card that repairs the full defect. S1C51::M-SWEEP remains the appropriate admissible direct measurement of the modified chemistry's 80-130 C response and processing-window levels. However, as specified, one candidate preparation without a concurrent E2 reference cannot defensibly yield the matched candidate-versus-E2 percentage change or discriminate the three registered level hypotheses at 3.40%, given historical E2 CVs of 58.48% at 120 C and 54.07% at 130 C and approximately 3.3-3.6-fold spread. Its result may therefore establish the candidate's absolute viscosity level and chemistry-specific thermal-response shape, but hypothesis acceptance or falsification requires a concurrent E2 reference, independent preparations, an uncertainty threshold reflecting preparation variability, and a guard band around the inert-dilution boundary. The dual-axis formulation also prevents modifier-specific causal attribution. These limitations change the permissible interpretation rather than favoring another tied card, because all five tied cards use the same one-preparation M-SWEEP plan and share the relevant deficiencies.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: The proposed S1C51::M-SWEEP is one of five experiments in the base tied top set. The tied top set was unchanged in all 29 tested scenarios: each weight was independently scaled from 0.5 to 1.5, top_experiment_set_stability was 1.0, and every recommendation_flip_boundary reports survival across the entire sweep with no flip above or below the base weight. The base_margin_to_first_strictly_lower is 0.002292. Thus none of the tested perturbations changes the decision; no alternative weighting within the reported range needs scientific defense. This establishes only stability of the transparent score.

skeptic.chemistry_domain_support_assessment: The primary candidate viscosity readings remain inside the support generated by the proposed experiment because M-SWEEP directly measures S1C51 from 80 to 130 C and establishes its own modified-chemistry response shape. The proposal does not reuse the unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI shape to reconstruct the processing-window values. A one-point M-ANCHOR would be unsupported before this verification, but it is not the selected plan. Valid comparative interpretation still requires a concurrently prepared unmodified E2 reference and verified modifier reactivity or stoichiometry.
skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The instrument can produce 120 C and 130 C candidate readings, but the specified protocol cannot validly produce the matched candidate-versus-E2 percentage change with uncertainty needed to apply the falsification criteria. It lacks a concurrent E2 reference and independent preparations, while the declared 3.40% threshold is far below historical preparation variability. The association and plasticization criteria also classify values immediately on either side of -51.29% without a measurement-resolution guard band.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A realization-state displacement could be mistaken for support or falsification of a level hypothesis, so the experiment cannot validly claim to separate all three registered hypotheses at 3.40% resolution.
objections.objection: The claimed 3.40 percentage-point discrimination threshold is not the applicable resolution for a one-preparation comparison. Historical E2 variability is 58.48% CV at 120 C and 54.07% CV at 130 C, with max/min ratios of 3.57 and 3.34. The protocol specifies only one freshly prepared candidate sample and no independent preparations. Although the preregistered S1C51 predictions are numerically separated by 37.50 percentage points between H-LEVEL-DILUTE (-51.29%) and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC (-88.79%), that smallest separation is below the observed 120-130 C preparation variability. The planner explicitly requires replacing 3.4% with the larger repeatability bound when independent-preparation variability is larger.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The reported percentage change against E2, and therefore comparison with -51.29%, +28.71%, and -88.79%, would lack a valid matched reference and could not adjudicate the registered predictions.
objections.objection: The observable is defined as a matched-temperature percentage change against the unmodified E2 reactive core, but the selected M-SWEEP protocol only says to sweep one freshly prepared candidate from 80 to 130 C. It does not include the planner-required matched unmodified E2 reference under the same preparation and measurement order. Historical E2 measurements are not an adequate substitute because their 120-130 C realization spread is approximately 3.3-3.6-fold.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment may classify the net behavior of this dual-axis formulation relative to three numerical predictions, but it cannot establish modifier-specific attribution or independently test the claimed acrylic-only association contribution.
objections.objection: S1C51 changes both modifier axes simultaneously: AC1920 is 20.0 wt% and TK100 is 5.0 wt%, while the reactive-core fraction falls to 0.75. Consequently, an elevation above inert dilution cannot be attributed specifically to the acrylic-like axis as stated by H-LEVEL-ASSOC; it could arise from TK100, an AC1920-by-TK100 interaction, or a changed realization state. Likewise, a depression cannot identify whether acrylic-like material, tackifier-like material, their interaction, or dilution caused it.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A discrepancy from the preregistered dilution value could reflect an incorrect reactive-fraction or NCO:OH calculation rather than association or plasticization.
objections.objection: The dilution prediction assumes reactive mass fraction phi_r = 0.75, but the supplied E2 anchor states that true stoichiometry must be recalculated if a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group. No verified AC1920 or TK100 functionality is included in the proposed protocol. Thus -51.29% is conditional on treating the entire 25 wt% modifier fraction as non-reactive.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Calling the full primary observable directly measured would overstate interpretability; only the candidate's absolute 120 C and 130 C readings are direct, not the matched candidate-versus-E2 change required for hypothesis testing.
objections.objection: The candidate viscosities at 120 C and 130 C are directly measured by M-SWEEP and do not require extrapolation or the shared-shape fit. However, the stated primary comparison—percentage change against unmodified E2—is not directly obtainable from the specified candidate-only protocol. It requires either an unlisted concurrent reference measurement or use of a historical/imputed E2 level. The fitted E_eta descriptor is secondary and appropriately not used as the primary level observable.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: There is no unsupported shared-shape-transfer claim to invalidate here; the remaining weaknesses concern matched referencing, replication, and causal attribution.
objections.objection: No chemistry-domain support violation is present in the selected measurement itself. S1C51 is outside the unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI family, but M-SWEEP directly measures 80-130 C and verifies the thermal-response shape for the AC1920-plus-TK100 chemistry. It does not reconstruct 120-130 C values from the unmodified-family shape.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The protocol could generate a numerical value satisfying the written inequalities, but it could not produce a defensible falsification at the declared resolution.
objections.objection: The stated criteria use a 3.40 percentage-point threshold for H-LEVEL-DILUTE and exact inert-dilution boundaries for H-LEVEL-ASSOC and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC, but the protocol has one candidate preparation, no matched E2 preparation, and no uncertainty interval for the candidate-versus-reference change. It therefore cannot establish that a departure greater than 3.40 points is larger than preparation variability. The directional criteria also omit a resolution guard band: a result arbitrarily close to -51.29% is classified as falsifying H-LEVEL-ASSOC or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC solely according to which side it falls on.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A successful level result could be incorrectly presented as evidence that S1C51 avoids the declared hot-hold failure mode, even though no residence-time trajectory is measured.
objections.objection: No reliance on the unmeasured target outcome is evident in the supplied proposal, and the proposer explicitly limits the result to formulation-level rheological behavior rather than a molecular mechanism. It also admits that M-SWEEP does not adjudicate thermal-hold drift. However, because the declared failure mode is excessive 120 C hold drift and the scientific question asks whether the formulation avoids E5-like growth, this experiment alone cannot answer the full decision question.

skeptic.recommended_change: Augment S1C51::M-SWEEP with a concurrently prepared unmodified E2 sweep in the same measurement order and at least three independent preparations of each composition. Preregister the larger observed between-preparation uncertainty as the discrimination threshold rather than automatically using 3.40%, verify whether AC1920 or TK100 contributes NCO-reactive functionality before fixing phi_r = 0.75, and include acrylic-only and tackifier-only sweep controls if modifier-specific attribution is intended. Keep the separate repeated 120 C matched-window hold requirement for the hot-hold failure-mode claim.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The claimed 3.40% three-hypothesis discrimination is not achievable with one candidate preparation and no concurrent matched E2 reference, given E2 CVs of 58.48% at 120 C and 54.07% at 130 C and approximately 3.3-3.6-fold max/min spread.

tool_trace.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: This mandatory upstream audit must be loaded before any candidate or experiment ranking; it establishes the chemistry provenance, shared-shape evidence, state-shift behavior, calibration error, and original hold contrast.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation is excluded from the primary same-composition fit and is interpreted separately as a chemical-perturbation check.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.
Keep deliberately chemistry-perturbed curves outside same-composition fitting, but use them to test whether an intervention shifts viscosity scale, thermal-response shape, or both.

chemical_perturbation_check.interpretation: The verified low-dose H3PO4 perturbation shifts the observed viscosity level while remaining closely compatible with the local shared thermal-response geometry. It is a separate chemical-perturbation check and is not pooled into the primary same-composition state model.

observational_E1_R01_day1_comparator.interpretation_boundary: Observational reference only; the compact record does not establish a paired parent-batch relationship between E1 +P and E1 R01 day-1.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.
experiment_design_implications.verified_acid_perturbation: E1 +P received 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution during dehydration. Its close agreement with the primary shared thermal shape makes it useful as a defined scale-versus-shape perturbation check, not as another nominal E1 realization.

provenance_audit.reason: E1 +P is a verified chemical perturbation: 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution was added during dehydration. It is excluded from the same-composition primary state model and exposed separately as a perturbation check.

PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

chemistry_applicability_audit.enforcement_note: In this condition the chemistry applicability audit is BINDING. The cards it marks inadmissible were removed before ranking and are not selectable. You may state that you disagree with the rule and why; naming a removed card is an invalid output.
rule_text: Scope: measurement admissibility, not formulation admissibility.
M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT and M-SWEEP observe their quantity directly and remain admissible.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct sweep has verified transferability for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification: the one-point anchor would reconstruct 120-130 C viscosity through a shape that has never been measured for that chemistry.
This audit is a deterministic scientific rule, not a VOI penalty and not a model opinion. Whether it is binding in this run is stated by the enforcement field.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.

measurement_plan.protocol: Measure viscosity from 80 to 130 C in 10 C increments on a freshly prepared sample and regress ln(eta) against 1/T.

top_cards.acceptance_criterion: The measured 120-130 C level change against the unmodified reactive core falls within 3.40% of exactly one registered prediction: -47.12% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 12.88% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC or -80.87% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. That hypothesis is accepted for this composition and the processing-window level is reported with it.
top_cards.admissibility_reason: The 80-130 C sweep is the direct verification measurement that establishes the thermal-response shape for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

budget_efficiency_detail.definition: 1 - effort_points / max(effort_points) over the declared catalog

top_cards.falsification_criterion: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured level change is at or below the inert-dilution prediction of -47.12%. H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above that same prediction. H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured level change departs from -47.12% by more than the 3.40% resolution of this plan.
